description.value: Woodfire is a contemporary dine-in and takeout restaurant situated in the award-winning Madrona Marketplace at the heart of Gabriola Island village, helmed by classically French-trained Chef Chris Hooton with over 40 years of experience. The menu features wood-fired pizzas, fine Italian pasta, and West Coast seafood and grill items, all made in-house from fresh, locally sourced ingredients. The restaurant participates in the Vancouver Aquarium's Ocean Wise sustainable seafood initiative and the Island Good Initiative, and also offers full catering services.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched and confirms the business is a real, operating restaurant at the OSM address (Madrona Marketplace Unit 1, 500 North Road, Gabriola Island). The main phone number on the website (250 247 0095) matches the OSM phone tag. Takeout is explicitly and repeatedly confirmed on the website; no evidence exists in either OSM tags or website content for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or most optional amenities.
concerns: OSM name is 'Woodfire' but the website consistently uses the fuller name 'Woodfire Restaurant & Catering'. OSM value retained per rules.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating restaurant on Gabriola Island with confirmed address, phone, and website. Useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a meal or takeout.
